intro.title: Components
intro.hint: Every shell component with its stable annotations. Roots carry data-ux, key regions carry data-ux-part — usable directly as TourGuide anchors and E2E selectors.
intro.appshell: App shell: vertically composes the title bar, menu bar, main work area and status bar — the root container of the window layout.
intro.titlebar: Frameless title bar: brand/title left, content center, actions and window controls right (controls injected by PlatformAdapter).
intro.activitybar: Activity bar: vertical icon navigation with single-select highlight, switching left panels.
intro.statusbar: Status bar: status summary left, badges and actions right; fixed 26px height.
intro.dock: Dock workbench: left/right/bottom/center zones + drag to re-dock/float + float layer + bottom-right minimize stack; state held by useDockLayout.
intro.panel: Dockable panel: draggable header + dock / float / minimize / close buttons; double-click header toggles float.
intro.float: Floating panel: drag header to move, drag bottom-right corner to resize, click to focus (z increments).
intro.splitter: Splitter: pointer drag + keyboard (←↑↓→ / Shift to accelerate / Home / End), role=separator.
intro.splitpane: Split pane: horizontal or vertical two-pane split, ratio clamped 20%–80%, reuses UxSplitter.
intro.tabs: Tab strip: roving tabindex + ←→/Home/End navigation, middle-click close, drag reorder, right-click bulk close, unsaved dot.
intro.composables: Headless logic: useDockLayout (ownership/size/float/minimize/persistence) and useTabs (open/activate/bulk close/reorder).

tour.label: Workbench layout tour
tour.s1Desc: App title and brand area (left); actions and window controls on the right (injected by PlatformAdapter).
tour.s2Desc: Vertical icon navigation; click to switch the left dock panel; the active item is highlighted.
tour.s3Desc: Drag a panel header: drop on a window edge to dock, drop in the center to float; double-click the header to toggle between dock and float.
tour.s4Desc: The tab strip (UxTabs) supports middle-click close, drag reorder and right-click bulk close; enabling split uses UxSplitPane for a two-pane layout.
tour.s5Desc: Logs / terminal panel; drag the splitter above to resize its height.
tour.s6Desc: Left shows the status summary and active panel; right shows key sizes and tab count.
tour.s7Desc: Below lists every shell component with its API and stable annotations (data-ux / data-ux-part), usable as anchors and E2E selectors.

tour.hint: Spotlight mask + keyboard (←→/Enter/Esc); completion is remembered in localStorage and won't auto-start next time.
tour.s1Desc:
This step has no anchor: the whole screen dims with a centered card.
Press Enter or "Next" to continue.
tour.s2Desc:
100,000 rows render only the visible window.
Click headers to sort, right-click a cell to copy, double-click to copy the row.
tour.s3Desc:
Category navigation on the left (↑↓ keyboard), content card on the right.
A footnote at the bottom notes that changes take effect immediately.
tour.s4Desc:
Press Esc to exit the tour anytime.
It won't auto-start again after refresh.
